NASA Discovers Moon is Actually Made of Giant Aged Provolone Cheese Wheel

By Spud McDanniels | Category: Humor & Parody

April 1, 2026

HOUSTON — In an emergency press briefing Monday, senior astrophysicists at NASA headquarters confirmed that after sixty years of lunar laser spectrometry and deep acoustic probing, the moon's crust is composed entirely of 70 quintillion metric tons of aged Italian provolone.

"For decades, we published papers claiming the lunar surface was basaltic regolith created by meteorite bombardment," confessed Chief Lunar Geologist Dr. Bartholomew Crumb while slicing off a wedge with a sterile titanium scalpel. "In reality, the Apollo astronauts immediately smelled sharp notes of cured dairy the moment they stepped off the lunar module ladder in 1969."

Space agency administrators confirmed that orbital probes have detected deep underground veins of smoked mozzarella near the Sea of Tranquility, prompting NASA to reconfigure its Artemis IV mission into an astronaut expedition of gourmet water crackers and artisanal prosciutto.

When asked about the discovery's gravitational implications, NASA officials admitted that tidal patterns on Earth are directly influenced by the natural aging process of the galactic provolone wheel.
